beta.approval: Manual approval is required before each publish=true beta run.

latest.approval: Not approved. Requires explicit human approval after all stable-readiness blockers are resolved.

requiredEvidence: stable registry readback defined and passing

registryReadback: npm view @atom63/ui-react@latest name version dist-tags dependencies --json

rollback.policy: Rollback is dist-tag first. Move latest back to the previous approved stable version or remove the accidental latest tag before considering a package republish.
commands: npm deprecate <package>@<bad-version> "Use <previous-stable-version>; this release was withdrawn."
notes: Never unpublish unless npm support and package-policy review approve it.
After rollback, rerun registry readback and adopter smoke before announcing the fix.
